title: deputyOS network-defaults (per-profile egress seed)
description: Schema for /etc/deputyos/network-defaults.json — a per-profile curated allow-list of hostnames baked at image time from roles/deputyos/files/network-defaults.<profile>.json. Read-only seed: `deputyctl network mode whitelist` copies `allow_hosts` into /etc/deputyos/network-policy.json only when the live policy's allow_hosts is empty (idempotent — a user-curated list is never clobbered). Schema version 1; bump on breaking changes.

profile.description: The profile id this defaults file was curated for (e.g. openclaw, hermes, khoj). Informational.

mode.description: Informational: the mode the profile recommends. Seeding only happens on a switch to `whitelist`; this field is not enforced.

allow_hosts.description: Hostnames permitted in `whitelist` mode — LLM providers, chat gateways, package indices the profile genuinely needs. Free-form hostnames (resolved to IPv4 at apply time; see the egress threat model for the DNS-only limitation).
